A man in a grey shirt sits at a desk in the background, facing away from the camera. (2) The boy stands up, wearing an orange t-shirt with a dinosaur graphic and blue trousers; he looks at the camera with a curious expression. The camera pans around the room, revealing a television screen, a world map on the wall, and various pieces of furniture. (3) The boy walks toward the shop entrance where another Corgi is standing; the first dog follows him. The camera follows his movement, showing stacked cardboard boxes and a wooden door frame. (4) The boy exits the shop onto a paved street area, continuing to look back at the dogs and wave. A white scooter is parked nearby, and the lighting shifts from bright indoor studio light to natural daylight as he moves outside.
